findings.text: removing the manifest-commits precondition makes delivered_run_owes_review hold the pane for a delivered run whose head cannot be resolved, which is the fixture of the three tests the head arm now fails: logs/head-arm.log records 481 passed and 3 failed against logs/base-arm.log's 477 passed and 0 failed, so the done_when's 'The test files importing reckon.crew.station_subscriber or reckon.crew_follow_commands add no failure against the base revision' is unmet and the node cannot land until a coordinator either extends scope to update those three tests or narrows the rule.

the new no-commit case asserts only that the pane holds and has no settle arm, and select_review_for_head (reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:138) returns no review for an empty head, so a live pointer with no resolvable head reads review-missing permanently and its pane never settles; the liveness risk is untested and no case shows the hold can ever end.

the broad 'except Exception: return False' around obligations._review_duty_item settles the pane whenever the duty cannot be read, which is the fail-open direction the rule exists to prevent: a corrupt review record or a malformed live pointer ends the follower over an owed review instead of holding it.

_review_grace is a third copy of the unreconciled_run_grace derivation, already inlined at reckon/crew/obligations.py:1783 and reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1294, so a change to how the grace resolves has three places to land in and the pane could read a different grace than the view it claims to agree with.

item_verdicts.diff: Read 6dedfa1b0c..52ac66ce2c commit by commit: three files, 148 insertions and 67 deletions, replacing the reconstructed scoring/tier rule with obligations._review_duty_item over one snapshot, one placements order and one grace per project, flipping the no-commit case from settle to hold, and advancing the injected clock in the settle waits.
item_verdicts.done_when: The five plan cases and both negative controls are present and recorded (logs/node-tests.log 7 passed EXIT=0; logs/negative-control.log both controls EXIT=1), but logs/head-arm.log records 481 passed and 3 failed against logs/base-arm.log's 477 passed and 0 failed, so the done_when's 'add no failure against the base revision' condition is unmet, and no ruff log was recorded for its ruff condition.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to keep a follower while its session owes a review; reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:108-124 now builds the run's review duty through obligations._review_duty_item and holds the pane when that duty reads review-missing, which does what the goal states.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records both commits, the node gate 7 passed, both controls reproduced, base 477 passed, head 481 passed with 3 failed, the three failure ids and their attribution, and names those failures as gating the merge; status reads complete while blockers and wait_condition are both populated, and the three out-of-scope test updates sit under blockers rather than the outside_scope field.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py, reckon/crew_follow_commands.py, tests/test_a_follower_stays_while_a_review_is_owed.py, the evidence fragment and the figures directory; the diff at 52ac66ce2c touches only the module, the test and the fragment, all inside them.

justifications.durability: the hold and settle cases redden under the recorded controls (logs/negative-control.log: 4 and 3 failures), but the new no-commit case at tests/test_a_follower_stays_while_a_review_is_owed.py:435 asserts only the hold and has no settle arm.
justifications.evidence: logs/node-tests.log (7 passed, EXIT=0) and logs/negative-control.log (both controls EXIT=1) are recorded, but logs/head-arm.log records 3 failures against a clean logs/base-arm.log (477 passed), so the done_when's 'add no failure against the base revision' is unmet, and no ruff receipt exists for its 'Ruff adds no findings on the staged paths'.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:109 reaches the private obligations._review_duty_item across a module boundary, coupling this module to an underscore symbol the plan asked it to read through.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:108-124 builds the run's duty through obligations._review_duty_item and holds exactly on kind review-missing, which is the plan's Deliverable, but it widens the hold past the five cases to a delivery whose head cannot be resolved.
justifications.reuse: delivered_run_owes_review delegates to the obligations owner rather than restating the rule, but reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:127 adds a third copy of the unreconciled_run_grace derivation already inlined at reckon/crew/obligations.py:1783 and reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1294.
